subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should same-session `openclaw agent` dispatch return a terminal lane-busy result after the wait threshold, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90933 remain the sponsored implementation path after repair?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes the user-visible delivery contract for queued CLI messages and the current candidate PR is still draft/waiting on author.

options.title: Sponsor the linked busy-result path
options.body: Keep the issue open and finish the linked PR so CLI callers get structured busy output while non-CLI Gateway calls preserve existing queuing behavior.

options.title: Keep queueing but improve timeout output
options.body: Reject terminal busy results and instead surface a clearer timeout/failure message without changing same-session queued delivery semantics.

options.title: Pause and redesign the contract
options.body: Hold the linked PR until maintainers define the CLI exit code, JSON shape, and compatibility boundary explicitly.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked busy-result path
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and finish the linked PR so CLI callers get structured busy output while non-CLI Gateway calls preserve existing queuing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Gateway-backed CLI relay and adjacent queue hardening history make this the strongest routing candidate for the user-visible CLI contract decision.
